Participants are found in SQL: walk `parent_id` to the top-level comment (its author is the starter), then one `aggregate` grouped by `author_id` where `parent_id` is the root, on the existing index. The reply author, everyone mentioned in this reply, and anyone the existing mention gate refuses (reads the record and the comment as the recipient) are dropped.
Basis: card #36074; epic #36062.
Scope, the seat's reading: a new `collab.reply` topic on the same entry and channels as `collab.mention`, in-app plus email, with a per-person 10-minute email bucket of its own (the same rule as mentions; the mention path is unchanged). Editing a reply sends nothing. The title says who replied, not the record's name, matching "mentioned you": a record name would need a second field-level check per recipient. That part of item 3 was the coordinating seat's own addition, not the maintainer's words, so the seat reads it this way and the PR body says so.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no fold. #36071 edits the same plugin in parallel; `overlap-check.mjs` before each push, and the second to land merges main. L1 at L1-a. The PR carries `Fixes #36074`.
